# skycloak_openfga_instance (Resource)

A dedicated OpenFGA instance bound to one realm of a cluster. The instance's API accepts only tokens issued by that realm. Creation waits until the instance is `ready`. Destroying the instance deletes all of its authorization data and cannot be undone. Changing `cluster_id` or `realm` replaces the instance. Requires a workspace with OpenFGA access. A realm can have only one instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_realm" "orders" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  name       = "orders"
}

# One OpenFGA instance per realm. Its API accepts tokens issued by that realm.
resource "skycloak_openfga_instance" "orders" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm      = skycloak_realm.orders.name
}

output "openfga_api_url" {
  value = skycloak_openfga_instance.orders.api_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Changing it replaces the instance.
- `realm` (String) Realm to bind. It must exist and be enabled on the cluster and cannot be `master`. Changing it replaces the instance.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) Where the instance's OpenFGA API answers.
- `audience` (String) The audience a token must carry. Add an audience mapper for this value to the realm's client.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Instance ID (UUID).
- `issuer` (String) The issuer the instance trusts. Only tokens from this issuer are accepted.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `provisioning`, `ready`, `failed` or `deleting`.
- `status_message` (String) The reason the instance is `failed`; empty otherwise.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import with `<cluster_id>/<instance_id>`.
terraform import skycloak_openfga_instance.orders 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7
```
